Privacy

The company identified below operates this website and controls the personal data it receives. We do not create child accounts or request children’s names, contact details or learning records. Please do not send children’s data to support.

We receive an adult’s email, message and order reference when they contact us; activation also uses a technical device identifier. Hosting may process IP addresses, request times and browser information for security. We use data to fulfil purchases, provide support, meet legal duties and protect the service, based on contract, legal obligation or legitimate interests as applicable. No advertising, profiling, data sales or automated decisions.

Authorised staff and hosting, email and payment providers process only the information needed for their roles; authorities may receive information when legally required. External checkout providers apply their own notices and may process data abroad. Any transfers we arrange require a valid legal mechanism. We keep support records only as needed for the request and related claims, activation records for the licence and required claims periods, and financial records for mandatory retention periods, then delete or anonymise them.

You may request access, correction, deletion, restriction or portability where applicable, and object or withdraw optional consent. Contact privacy@horizons-tr.com; proportionate identity verification may be needed. Turkish KVKK requests are answered within 30 days; applicable GDPR requests normally within one month. You may complain to the competent authority. This notice does not ask for consent.

This website sets no cookies and uses no analytics, advertising scripts or embedded third-party media. Its language is part of the URL; no preference is saved. The downloaded workbook stores progress locally. Optional update checks are off by default and contact our server only when chosen; ordinary connection information may be logged. External checkout has its own cookie policy.
